* The following extensions are listed in RFC 2459 as relevant to CRLs *

* Authority Key Identifier * Issuer Alternative Name * CRL Number * Delta CRL Indicator (critical) * Issuing Distribution Point (critical)

methods.name: public boolean hasUnsupportedCriticalExtension()
methods.comment:
* Will return true if any extensions are present and marked
     * as critical as we currently dont handle any extensions!

methods.comment:
* Returns a string representation of this CRL.
     *
     * @return a string representation of this CRL.

methods.name: public boolean isRevoked(Certificate cert)
methods.comment:
* Checks whether the given certificate is on this CRL.
     *
     * @param cert the certificate to check for.
     * @return true if the given certificate is on this CRL,
     * false otherwise.
